ICD-10: E11.22 - Type 2 diabetes with diabetic chronic kidney disease
ehr_visits.clinical_notes: 57-year-old South Asian male with newly diagnosed hypertension and early chronic kidney disease. Family history significant for CAD and hypertension. Current BP 155/95 with evidence of target organ damage including mild LVH on ECG and reduced eGFR with microalbuminuria. Diet-controlled diabetes with borderline glycemic control. Initiated ACE inhibitor therapy and dietary counseling provided.
ehr_visits.follow_up_plan: Return in 4 weeks to assess BP response to ACE inhibitor. Dietitian consultation for low-sodium DASH diet and diabetes management. Home BP monitoring initiated. Repeat basic metabolic panel and urinalysis in 2 weeks to monitor for hyperkalemia. Consider echocardiogram if BP not controlled at next visit.

ehr_visits.clinical_notes: 58-year-old South Asian male with obesity, diet-controlled T2DM, and family history of HTN/CAD presents with newly diagnosed hypertension and early signs of CKD stage 2. Blood pressure elevated at 155/95 with mild LVH on ECG. Laboratory studies reveal mild elevation in creatinine (1.35) with eGFR of 70 and microalbuminuria (ACR 45). HbA1c borderline at 6.3% suggesting suboptimal glucose control. Physical exam notable for mild bilateral ankle edema and S4 gallop consistent with early diastolic dysfunction.
ehr_visits.follow_up_plan: Start Lisinopril 10mg daily, low sodium diet counseling (<2g/day), diabetes education referral, repeat labs in 4 weeks to monitor creatinine and electrolytes, ophthalmology referral for diabetic eye exam, return visit in 6 weeks, home BP monitoring recommended

diagnosis_codes: ICD-10: E11.22 (Type 2 diabetes with diabetic chronic kidney disease)
ICD-10: D63.1 (Anemia in chronic kidney disease)
ehr_visits.clinical_notes: 58-year-old South Asian male with progression of CKD to stage 3b. eGFR declined from previous 52 to 45 mL/min/1.73m². Persistent proteinuria with ACR 385 mg/g indicates ongoing kidney damage. Echocardiogram confirms development of left ventricular hypertrophy and diastolic dysfunction consistent with hypertensive heart disease. Blood pressure remains poorly controlled on current ACE inhibitor therapy. Hyperkalemia noted at 5.2 mEq/L, likely related to ACE inhibitor use and declining kidney function. Early anemia of CKD developing with Hgb 11.2 g/dL. Diabetes remains well-controlled with diet.
ehr_visits.follow_up_plan: Added Amlodipine 5mg daily for BP control. Monitor potassium levels in 1 week given hyperkalemia. Nephrology referral initiated for CKD management. Consider iron studies and EPO evaluation for anemia workup. Dietary counseling for low potassium diet. Renal function monitoring in 6-8 weeks. Cardiology follow-up in 3 months for heart failure risk stratification.

diagnosis_codes: ICD-10: D63.1 (Anemia in chronic kidney disease)
ehr_visits.clinical_notes: 58-year-old South Asian male with obesity, type 2 diabetes, and family history of cardiovascular disease presenting with progression to CKD stage 3b. eGFR has declined to 45 mL/min with persistent proteinuria. Echocardiogram confirms left ventricular hypertrophy and diastolic dysfunction consistent with hypertensive heart disease. Blood pressure remains poorly controlled despite ACE inhibitor therapy. Development of anemia of chronic kidney disease with hemoglobin 11.2 g/dL. Hyperkalemia noted at 5.2 mEq/L requires monitoring. Added amlodipine for improved BP control. Patient counseled on dietary potassium restriction and CKD progression.
ehr_visits.follow_up_plan: Nephrology referral initiated for CKD management. Recheck labs in 2 weeks including basic metabolic panel and CBC. Blood pressure monitoring at home. Dietary consultation for CKD and potassium restriction. Consider iron studies and erythropoiesis-stimulating agents if anemia progresses. Follow-up in cardiology clinic in 6 weeks. Patient education on CKD progression and cardiovascular risk reduction provided.

diagnosis_codes: ICD-10: I13.2 (Hypertensive heart and chronic kidney disease with heart failure and stage 1-4 CKD)
ICD-10: D63.1 (Anemia in chronic kidney disease)
ehr_visits.clinical_notes: 58-year-old South Asian male with CKD stage 4 (eGFR 25, Cr 3.0) presenting with new-onset atrial fibrillation confirmed on Holter monitoring and evidence of cardiorenal syndrome type 4. Significant fluid overload with elevated BNP. Anemia of CKD with Hgb 9.8. Hypertension poorly controlled on triple therapy. Diabetes remains diet-controlled with acceptable HbA1c. CHA2DS2-VASc score 4, warranting anticoagulation with renally-dosed apixaban. Patient counseled on progression to ESRD and need for renal replacement therapy planning.
ehr_visits.follow_up_plan: 1. Vascular surgery consult for arteriovenous fistula creation within 2 weeks. 2. Cardiology follow-up in 1 week for atrial fibrillation management and rate control optimization. 3. Nephrology follow-up in 2 weeks. 4. Initiate erythropoiesis-stimulating agent (epoetin alfa) for anemia management. 5. Dietitian consultation for CKD and heart failure diet. 6. Pre-dialysis education class scheduled. 7. Repeat labs in 1 week including CBC, CMP, PT/INR. 8. Consider uptitration of diuretics if no improvement in fluid status.
